verdict.rationale: The product is an Agent Skill driven by an agent through natural-language prompts, plus dependency-free Python tools and a command-line searchable logo library. No documented public API (HTTP, SDK or programmatic interface spec) is evidenced. The local CLI tools are an adjacent feature, not a documented public API, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
